resources.string: Watches which app is in front so Not a Fraud can block time-sink apps, earn credits from focus apps, and keep the notification bar current. It reads which app is open; inside web browsers, the web address in the address bar, so blocked sites like instagram.com can be blocked too; and on the phone\'s own Settings screens, the screen\'s labels, to notice pages that would switch Not a Fraud off. It never reads page content in other apps, messages or passwords.
